title: Herbaceous Uruguayan Chicken Empanadas
description: A cultured and tender empanada featuring bread flour, a flavorful tadka, and Ayurvedic tamasic-friendly flavor.

ingredients.name: Tadka
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp ground turmeric, 1 tsp chili powder

instructions: In a bowl, combine bread flour, yeast, and salt.
Add warm water and olive oil to the flour mixture and mix until dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 60 minutes or until doubled in size.
While dough rises, heat the olive oil in a pan and add the tadka spices, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until onion soft.
Stir in shredded chicken, parsley, cilantro, tomato paste, tamarind paste, and cooked tadka; season with salt and cook for 5 minutes, then remove from heat.
Punch down risen dough, divide into 12 equal pieces, roll each into a circle about 12cm in diameter.
Spoon a tablespoon of filling onto the center of each dough circle, fold over, and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Place assembled empanadas on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Let empanadas cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
